posts.text: 6 months of planning. Countless iterations. One massive win. Sometimes, hard work really does pay off! I am absolutely thrilled to announce that our team took home the Best Hardware Project award at the Canadian Tech Summit 2026! 🏆 For the past half-year, we poured our energy into developing an interactive space simulation exhibit. The centerpiece? A custom-built physical glove that allows users to literally reach in and interact with virtual objects within the simulation. But a vision is nothin

I’m excited to share that I'll be spending this summer working at Vista Solutions Inc. as a Machine Vision Engineer! A massive thank you to Robertson Brown for this incredible opportunity and for believing in my potential. I'm looking forward to getting started and contributing to the team!
